method: Reused current candidate source, current regressions, prior route/source audits, and reran complete local build plus fixture browser suite. No app source was changed because the audited defects had already been implemented and covered.

Candidate already contains main PR #90 dependency patch at merge base f00bd12; Next is 16.3.6 and lockfile/security assertions match main.
ResponsiveUxController sets route dataset and owns responsive/print CSS; inspection found no semantic text or control rewriting in it.

Prior candidate browser evidence plus this run's fixture suite cover 29 actual routes and 390/768/1440 widths with no page overflow/errors.
Business-hour/capacity, waiting-service, cancel scope, print paper/no-total, and customer/vehicle search rules remain covered by existing scripts in the full build.

Current production dependency audit was re-run and remains blocked by the unchanged braces advisory path.

Customer/vehicle lookup, arrival hours and capacity, work-order cancellation scope, A4/A3/blank-slip printing, and exclusion of totals remain unchanged and regression-covered.

SPEC_DECISION_REQUIRED: None newly discovered. Full standalone ICB-SPEC v1.3/v1.4 was not found in current repo; inherited rules were audited from the app ledger, migration source, regressions, and accepted current user contract. No absent rules were invented.

remaining_limitations: Multi-RPC writes are not atomic; existing current-page stop and recovery behavior does not provide transactionality/idempotency.
Loaner demand and workload lists retain their documented finite caps and sentinel disclosure.
Generic concurrent offset pagination has no snapshot guarantee.
Inherited A3 screen preview width remains unchanged.
files_changed_by_this_run: Evidence only; no application, database, OCR, dependency, workflow, production, or spec source edits.
